item.title: Google Must Pay $425 Million In Class Action Over Privacy, Rules Court

media:content.media:description: The jury tells Google to pay $425 million over app privacy.

item.description: A federal jury determined on Wednesday that Alphabet's Google must pay $425 million in a class action lawsuit that accused it of continuing to collect data for millions of users who had switched off a tracking feature in their Google account.
